items.statement: The submission defines and preserves candidate identities, reports pose/conformer coverage and deduplication, and validates matched WT/A395G sampling before selecting an explanation.
items.expected: Candidate-level pose definitions, advancement/rejection context, coverage/stopping rule, atom mapping, convergence and sensitivity evidence are all present.

items.statement: The best-supported comparison favors more productive catalytic geometry for A395G than WT.
items.expected: Across the investigator's retained candidates or an honestly bounded failure, the reported distributions and productive-frame analysis address both states and support A395G-favored geometry or clearly explain non-discrimination.

items.statement: The structural explanation must address substrate hydrogen bonding and stability, not only one distance.
items.expected: OH_Y532–O3_sub interaction occupancy and RMSD/RMSF or equivalent stability evidence are reported and interpreted with limitations.
